settings.title: SKIP A DELIVERY
settings.text: Push the next shipment without cancelling the plan.

settings.title: CHANGE THE DATE
settings.text: Move your renewal earlier or later to match how fast you go through a bottle.

settings.title: SWAP YOUR PLAN
settings.text: Move between the Monthly, 3-Month and 6-Month plans at any time.

settings.title: UPDATE CARD OR ADDRESS
settings.text: Change the payment method or where the parcel goes.

settings.title: PAUSE
settings.text: Stop deliveries for a while and pick up where you left off.

settings.title: CANCEL
settings.text: End the subscription outright. No fee, no minimum term, no phone call.

settings.title: MANAGE YOUR SUBSCRIPTION
settings.subtitle: Skip a delivery, change the date, swap your plan or cancel — all from your own portal, without emailing anyone.
settings.card_text: Enter the email address you used at checkout and we will send you a secure link. No password to remember — the link takes you straight into your subscription.
settings.note: The link is valid for a short time and only works for the email on the order.
settings.actions_title: WHAT YOU CAN DO IN THERE
settings.help_text: Write to support@upmen.com from any address and tell us the order number. We will sort it out within one business day — and we can skip, pause or cancel for you directly.
